set.body: Acceptance: a psychology-facing result artifact exposes tidy typed rows for trial/AOI dwell, proportion, first entry, run count, and transitions; every row carries participant/trial/condition keys, estimand, value, unit, frame and clock specs, detector card/config, excluded and unclassified time, sample-origin counts, warnings, operation provenance, and SHA-256 input identity; deterministic RFC-4180 CSV export preserves missing values explicitly and round-trips; explain/report APIs require no kernel knowledge; schema/order/escaping/provenance-loss mutants fail on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Golden workflow: tidy result, explanation report, and deterministic CSV export
